Dear [Mr Furnivall](../persons.html#531)
I am afraid I cannot now read the books mentioned, as they have drifted out of my reach and I have much less time than I had in the old times when it was undertaken[^1]

Yours truly
C.M.

Yonge

[^1]: CMY and her mother had been recruited by Furnivall among the readers collecting quotations for the [project](../others.html#151) which was to become the New English Dictionary.
